heading: Admission & How to Apply
introHeading: Begin Your Journey Towards a Rewarding Career in Healthcare
introPara1: Dr. Vithalrao Vikhe Patil Foundation's Paramedical Institute invites applications from enthusiastic and motivated students who aspire to build a successful career in the healthcare sector. Our one-year certificate programmes are designed to provide quality, affordable and skill-oriented education with extensive practical training in a reputed multispecialty teaching hospital.
introPara2: Whether you are seeking a career-oriented professional qualification, our programmes provide an excellent opportunity to acquire practical skills and become employment-ready in one year.
eligibilitySub: Applicants should fulfil the following eligibility requirements:
eligibility1: Passed Secondary School Examination or its equivalent from a recognized Board with science as one of the subjects.
eligibility2: Candidates should be medically fit to undergo practical and clinical training.
eligibility3: Applicants should possess good communication skills, a positive attitude and a genuine interest in serving the healthcare profession.
durationHeading: Duration of the Course: One Year
processSub: Admissions are conducted on a first-come, first-served basis, subject to fulfilment of eligibility criteria and availability of seats.
step1Body: Fill up the application form online through the Institute's website.
step2Title: 2. Pay the Application Fee through UPI and Obtain the Screenshot
step2Body: Pay the application fee through UPI and obtain the screenshot as proof of payment.
step3Title: 3. Upload Documents and Submit the Application
step3Body: Upload documents and submit the application along with the prescribed details.
step4Body: Document verification by the Admission Committee.
step5Body: Payment of the prescribed admission fee.
step6Body: Confirmation of admission and issue of Identity Card.
step7Body: Orientation Programme and commencement of classes.
documentsSub: Applicants should submit self-attested copies of the following documents online, followed by original documents along with four passport-size photographs for verification:
importantNoteText: Students must scan the provided QR code, complete the payment, and upload a clear screenshot of the successful payment receipt along with the required documents.
selectionFinal: The decision of the Admission Committee shall be final.
feeExtra: In addition, students shall bear other charges as applicable, including examination fees, certification fees, educational tour / field visit expenses, study materials and practical record books, and any other charges prescribed by NCVRT or the Institute from time to time.
formFeeSub: Download the admission form, or pay the application fee online via QR.
scanToPay: Scan the QR code to pay your application fee online.
feeQrAlt: Scan to pay the application fee
ctaText: Browse our course catalogue or reach out directly — our admissions team is here to help.
